description: Global UI defaults — dataset-wide majority (persona/device/mood = Any). Used by Adaptive Engine to fill missing tokens after master matrix lookup.

tokens.hero_banner_size: Medium Split (Takes up half the screen)
tokens.desktop_navigation: Top Bar (Categories always visible across the top)
tokens.mobile_navigation: Bottom Nav (Navigation bar at the bottom - mobile style)
tokens.desktop_search_visibility: Always Visible Top (Large, prominent search bar always shown)
tokens.mobile_search_visibility: Collapsible (Search bar that expands when clicked)
tokens.desktop_filter_location: Sidebar Left (Permanent filter panel on the left side)
tokens.mobile_filter_location: Drawer Overlay (Slides in from the side when clicked)
tokens.mobile_sticky_header: Yes (Header stays at top while scrolling)
tokens.desktop_info_density: Moderate (Balanced - some details visible, click for more)
tokens.mobile_info_density: Moderate (Balanced - some details visible, click for more)
tokens.recommendation_type: Deals (Products on sale or special offers)
tokens.urgency_pref: Both (Show both stock and time based urgency)
tokens.checkout_style: One Page (All checkout steps on a single scrolling page)
tokens.desktop_product_card: Info Rich (Lots of details, ratings, specs visible)
tokens.mobile_product_card: Info Rich (Lots of details, ratings, specs visible)
tokens.mobile_review_display: Collapsible Sections (Reviews can be expanded or collapsed within the product details)
tokens.desktop_price_display: With Savings Highlighted (Shows discount amount prominently)
tokens.mobile_price_display: Strike-through Original (Shows original price crossed out with sale price)
tokens.font_style_pref: 2. Classic Serif (Traditional fonts with decorative strokes like Times New Roman)
tokens.color_theme_pref: Warm Earthy (Browns, beiges, warm oranges - natural and cozy)
tokens.desktop_quick_view: Sidebar Slide (Details slide in from the right)
tokens.mobile_quick_view: Slide-Up Panel (Preview product details in a slide-up panel without leaving the product lis)
tokens.mobile_grid_pref: Compact stacked cards (more products per screen)
tokens.form_field_style: Rounded Border Fields (Outlined field with rounded corners)
tokens.product_desc_length: Moderate (Key details with option to expand)
